cutters: Lacquer Cut at The Gramophone Co. Ltd.

notes.text:
Original UK release on blue Starline labels, issued in a matt, textured sleeve printed in black and white.
First catalogue number on cover and labels, 2nd (EMI international cat.#) in parentheses on cover back top right.

Sleeve:
• 'A Bizarre Collection Of Antiques & Curios' on front cover artwork.
• stereo, The tracks marked Ø

are mono recordings electronically reprocessed to give a stereo effect on stereo equipment.
• E.M.I Records (The Gramophone Company Ltd) Hayes • Middlesex • England
• Made and printed in Great Britain 
• 7105 TPS Printed and made by Garrod & Lofthouse Ltd.
• File under POPULAR : Pop Groups

Labels:
• 'The Gramophone Co Ltd' perimeter rim text, EMI logo at 6 o'clock with 'Made In Gt. Britain' below it.

℗ 1967: A1 to A5, B6.
℗ 1968: B1, B2.
℗ 1969: B3, B4.
℗ 1971: B5.

Publishing:
• A1: Dunmo Music.
• A2 to A5, B1, B6: Essex Music International.
• B2, B3, B4: Lupus Music.
• B5: World Copyrights Ltd., World Music.

Duration of B2 is stated as being 7:45 on rear sleeve. The actual duration is 5:41, derived from stopwatch-timing it.

Runouts are stamped.
